installation_summary: Installed Audiominer 2.4.0 from the checked-out repo at /workspace using the documented Docker Compose CPU method. Working directory for deployment: /workspace/deployments/example-opencode. Pulled images from registry.opencode.de/bpa/audiominer/audiominer (web-service, fs-watcher, asr-service:latest) plus library/redis:7 (public pull, no login required). Created `.env` from `.env-example` with a placeholder HF_TOKEN. Started detached with `docker compose --env-file .env-example --env-file .env -f compose.yml -f compose.cpu.yml up -d`. All 4 containers (redis, web-service, fs-watcher, asr-service) are Up. ASR downloaded ~3 GB of Whisper large-v3 models into .local/models and initialized. Verified via HTTP: public UI http://localhost:8090 returns 200, admin UI http://localhost:8091 returns 200, API /docs and /openapi.json return 200. Access points: public web UI 8090, admin UI 8091, file watch dir /workspace/deployments/example-opencode/watch. Notify service remains commented out as shipped; no real HF token supplied; no transcription job was run.
additional_actions: Substituted a placeholder value for HF_TOKEN in deployments/example-opencode/.env because the guide requires a token but none was provided; the default public model still downloaded successfully.
Skipped the documented docker login to registry.opencode.de because the required images were publicly pullable without credentials.
Used `docker compose up -d` (detached) instead of the foreground `up` shown in the guide to allow non-interactive verification.
verification: docker compose ... ps showed all 4 services Up (exit 0). curl http://127.0.0.1:8090/ returned HTTP 200 with the Audiominer public UI HTML (exit 0). curl http://127.0.0.1:8091/ returned HTTP 200 with the Audiominer admin UI HTML (exit 0). curl http://127.0.0.1:8090/docs and /openapi.json returned HTTP 200. web-service logs show MQ handshakes and "Uvicorn running on http://0.0.0.0:8090"; asr-service logs show "Application startup complete" after model download. All checks passed.
